subject: english
question:
**Select the option that will improve the (bracketed) part of the sentence. In case of no improvement select the option 'No improvement'.**

When you ride a horse, (you sat on it and control it's) movements.

options.text: you sit on it and afterwards control it's
you seated on it and control it's
you sit on it and control its

solution: **The correct answer is option 3: "you sit on it and control its movements."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The original sentence is grammatically incorrect because it uses the past tense "sat" instead of the present tense "sit.
